title: Senior Growth & Marketing UX/UI Designer
description:
Senior Growth & Marketing UX/UI Designer

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Remote initially, in-office when new hub opens)

You’re a growth-driven UX/UI designer who loves shipping experiments that move metrics. You’ll own high-impact designs for two distinct travel brands:

  • See Sight Tours: Our established tour company. You’ll optimize our website’s product pages, booking funnels, and conversion-driven UX flows to maximize direct bookings.
  • Tripshepherd: Our innovative, video-first travel marketplace and app connecting travelers, local hosts, and creators. You’ll drive user acquisition, retention, and referral growth through engaging mobile and web experiences.
What You’ll Do

Growth Experimentation

  • Lead A/B tests and iterative designs for landing pages, checkout funnels, onboarding flows, emails, ads, and in-app experiences.
  • Rapidly translate analytics insights (CTR, signup rates, activation, retention) into actionable UX/UI improvements.

High-Impact Prototyping & Interaction Design

  • Craft intuitive onboarding, referral, and retention flows across web and native apps, using prototypes and micro-interactions (Figma, Lottie, Framer Motion).
  • Develop modular templates enabling quick experimentation by marketing and product teams.

Analytics, Research, and User Insight

  • Monitor and analyze key UX metrics in GA4, Mixpanel, and Amplitude; perform cohort and funnel analyses.
  • Pair quantitative data with qualitative methods—user interviews, usability tests, heatmaps, and session replays—to uncover hidden insights.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Work closely with Adam (Head of Product & Design) and Brandon (Head of Marketing) to align design strategy and business goals.
  • Mentor junior designers and marketing team members on growth experimentation best practices and effective use of analytics.

Evangelize Experiment-Driven Culture

  • Regularly present results and insights in “growth demos,” fostering an environment that prioritizes testing, learning, and continuous improvement.
What You Bring
  • 5+ years experience as a UX/UI or Digital Product Designer with demonstrated results in growth, conversion optimization, or performance marketing contexts.
  • Proven ability to independently plan, execute, and measure successful UX/UI experiments.
  • Expert-level visual design skills, confident using design systems and building high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Comfortable with analytics tools (GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude) and basic SQL queries to inform your design decisions.
  • Strong storytelling and communication skills—able to clearly articulate insights and drive team alignment around data-backed strategies.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with marketplaces, creator-driven platforms, or social video apps.
  • Familiarity with email marketing tools (Braze, Iterable) and performance-ad creative.
  • Background in growth-hacking or digital experimentation communities.
How We Work
  • Hybrid flexibility: Remote-first now, transitioning to our new São Paulo office in a few months.
  • Autonomous role: Clear ownership, minimal bureaucracy, and trust to drive meaningful outcomes.
  • No travel requirement: Your research and user testing happens locally or remotely.
Why Join Us
  • Real Impact: Your designs directly influence thousands of travelers, creators, and local hosts around the globe.
  • Two Powerful Brands, One Mission: Blend the proven track record of See Sight Tours with the innovation and creativity of TripShepherd’s rapidly growing marketplace.
  • Purpose-Driven: We believe in community-centric, respectful tourism (“The TripShepherd Way”) and strive to leave every destination better than we found it.

Ready to join a high-growth team and make a measurable difference?

Submit your portfolio showing growth experiments you’ve led and the impact they delivered—we’d love to connect.

title: Almoxarife II
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência

Sobre o papel

Executar as atividades operacionais do almoxarifado da fábrica, garantindo o recebimento, armazenamento, controle e expedição eficiente de materiais, peças, ferramentas e equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos e contribuindo para a organização, segurança e disponibilidade dos itens para as áreas de produção e manutenção.

Atividades principais :

  • Receber e conferir os materiais entregues, verificando a correspondência com notas fiscais e ordens de compra, identificando avarias ou divergências e reportando ao superior imediato, assim como, realizar a descarga e movimentação dos materiais para as áreas de armazenamento;
  • Organizar, etiquetar e armazenar os materiais de forma adequada, seguindo as normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais, otimizando o espaço disponível e facilitando a identificação e o acesso;
  • Realizar o registro de entradas e saídas de materiais no sistema de controle de estoque, garantindo a atualização dos níveis, bem como, atuar na realização de inventários periódicos (cíclicos, rotativos e gerais), através de contagem e identificação de divergências;
  • Garantir acuracidade do estoque, cumprindo os procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs) de movimentações internas de materiais;
  • Separar e preparar os materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos solicitados pelas diversas áreas da fábrica, de acordo com as requisições, garantindo a precisão das entregas e a correta embalagem para transporte interno;
  • Utilizar equipamentos de movimentação de materiais (paleteiras, empilhadeiras, pontes rolantes - com a devida certificação e treinamento) para transportar, carregar e descarregar materiais dentro do almoxarifado e para as áreas de destino;
  • Manter o almoxarifado limpo, organizado e seguro, zelando pela conservação dos equipamentos e das instalações, solicitando manutenções preventivas nos equipamentos de movimentação, conforme manual e planos de manutenção;
  • Preencher e manter atualizados os registros de entrada e saída de materiais, checklists e outros documentos relacionados às atividades do almoxarifado;
  • Atender às solicitações das áreas de produção e manutenção, buscando e fornecendo os materiais necessários de forma ágil e eficiente;
  • Participar de treinamentos sobre procedimentos do almoxarifado, segurança no trabalho, operação de equipamentos e outras áreas relevantes para o desempenho da função;
  • Cumprir as normas de segurança no trabalho dentro do almoxarifado, utilizando de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e coletivos (EPCs) de acordo com o procedimento de cada atividade executada;
  • Outras atividades correlatas.

Qualificações :

  • Necessário Ensino Médio Completo;
  • CNH B;
  • Pacote Office;
  • SAP;

Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Desejável formação técnica em Logística, Almoxarifado ou áreas correlatas;

title: Supervisor de vendas
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Tem habilidade para liderar e inspirar? Esta vaga é para você! Você vai treinar e engajar a equipe, garantir um atendimento top e cuidar da gestão do estoque, levando nosso time a marcar golaços todos os dias.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Você será responsável por executar e garantir a execução dos processos de venda do setor de calçados, prestando atendimento de qualidade e zelando pela satisfação do cliente, conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento.

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Coordenar, acompanhar, treinar e orientar a equipe na realização das tarefas, garantindo que o padrão de atendimento seja seguido, fornecendo feedback diários com relação ao atendimento e ao desempenho, visando a melhoria contínua no alcance dos resultados.
  • Efetuar a gestão de estoque do setor, analisando o desempenho dos produtos, visando, assim, propor abertura e/ou adequação dos limites.
  • Realizar conferência qualitativa e quantitativa do setor, garantir que todos os produtos do setor estejam com preços marcados corretamente.
  • Realizar diariamente a reunião com o time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.
  • Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros) com os atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos.

Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação

SOBRE A CENTAURO:

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Técnico de Automação
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Analisar, padronizar e customizar os programas dos CLPs (Controlador Lógico Programável), manter backups atualizados destes e dos supervisórios, para manutenção da segurança de operação das máquinas e manutenção do sistema;
  • Analisar, padronizar e customizar interfaces de operação, supervisórios e/ou IHMs (interface homem máquina), a fim de facilitar a operação e melhorar a qualidade das informações dos processos;
  • Fazer manutenção, calibrar e controlar os instrumentos das instalações, visando melhoria na qualidade do produto, redução no custo de produção e confiabilidade do processo produtivo;
  • Executar serviços de manutenção eletromecânica, eletroeletrônica, eletropneumática, eletrotécnica e instrumentação industrial, para o funcionamento dos equipamentos e reparar ou substituir partes e peças dos equipamentos elétricos;
  • Monitorar as atividades de manutenção preventivas, preditivas e ou corretivas programadas, acompanhando a mão de obra contratada durante a execução das atividades, bem como, disponibilizando os recursos necessários para a realização da atividade;
  • Especificar e inspecionar equipamentos para automação das máquinas, e implementar melhorias para maior confiabilidade do processo produtivo e aumento da produtividade;
  • Monitorar a tecnologia de automação disponível do mercado para adaptação ao processo produtivo e implementar pequenos projetos de automação.

Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico completo em automação, eletromecânica e/ou eletrônica;
  • NR 10 básico e NR 10 SEP;
  • Conhecimento em manutenção de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Disponibilidade de horário para trabalhar em turnos;
  • Residir em Jaguariaíva ou Arapoti.

title: Senior Regulatory Specialist
description:
Job Overview:

Primary contact with investigative site(s) during site start-up activities and maintenance with responsibility for collection of the required investigator and essential documents for a study, to ensure EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority and any other local applications are made within the timelines agreed with project management and Site Readiness team and that documentation meets the specifications required by applicable regulations and sponsor. Proactively interacts with EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authorities to provide guidance regarding requirements. Maintain awareness of current regulatory standards related to submissions. Serve as local expert in project start-up activities for a particular country or region. Act as a ‘knowledge resource’ to mentor and train new hires and less-experienced department colleagues if suitable.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Maintain awareness of regulatory legislation, guidance, and practice in the assigned countries.
  • Coordinate, collect and organize data and information required by EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority including but not limited to the preparation of study documentation such as the country application form and cover letter for sponsor review as applicable.
  • Compile and prepare routine submission filed to IRB/IEC/Third body/Regulatory Authorities (e.g., INDs/CTAs) and liaise with them as applicable regarding submission/approval.
  • Liaise with internal and external vendors in the generation of Regulatory Authority submissions (as applicable).
  • Perform a review of final submission documents as applicable.
  • Ensure that all assigned start-up and maintenance activities are on track, in accordance with client expectations and budget and in compliance with applicable laws and guidelines, regulatory requirements, ICH/GCP, SOPs and quality standards
  • Prevent and escalate study issues appropriately and in a timely fashion.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management depending upon country and situational requirements with proper supervision (if applicable).
  • In Country specific tasks (Global):
  • Serve as primary contact for investigative sites and ensure documents required are collected in a timely manner.
  • Collect and track all the necessary documents required and perform a quality review, formatting, and compilation of the final documents for effective and compliant site activation and maintenance without supervision.
  • Ensure high quality documents are filed and systems are updated on an ongoing and timely basis, making Fortrea ready for an audit at any time.
  • Participate in team and project meetings as applicable.
  • When needed, assist in the strategy definition for Site Activation and provide accurate projections and timelines to study teams.
  • Review and customize country and site-specific patient informed consent forms for compliance with local requirements and protocol. Proactively resolve informed consent issues and other potential difficulties with study sites.
  • May support the negotiation of site contracts and budgets with sites, if applicable and track progress of contract and budget milestones/developments, intervening and escalating as appropriate.
  • Proactively identifying and escalating to Submission Leads any risk to meeting deliverables.
  • Notify the Submissions Lead of hours identified as Out-of-Scope or overburn.
  • Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) tasks (specific centralized role for EU):
  • Assist in the upload of submission documentation to, interacting with and monitoring of all notifications and alerts in CTIS to ensure all milestones and events for the trial are met within the timelines mandated.
  • Performs all other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • University/College degree (life science preferred), or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriate accredited institution (e.g., nursing certification, medical or laboratory technology) AND 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
  • In lieu of the above requirement, candidates with a High School Diploma or equivalent AND a minimum of 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations will be considered.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in clinical development or start-up/ regulatory process.
  • Working knowledge of ICH, RA, IRB/IEC, and other applicable regulations/guidelines; familiarity with investigator start-up documents and contract/budgets negotiation process; previous interaction with operational project teams and investigative sites.
  • Demonstrated understanding of research protocol requirements and proven ability to communicate them/educate others about them.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • General Office Environment.

title: Administrative Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Operations Admin to support our Central Operations team and US Operations markets in general administrative tasks and onboarding growth. If you are a well organized, analytical person with exceptional communication and problem solving skills then this role may be for you!

What You’ll Focus On:

  • Support our US Operations Cities on growth deliverables and efficiencies in our day to day work and operations
  • Automations for our ways of working when it comes to growth and portfolio changes
  • Analyze data in order to create and prepare detailed reports for the leadership team that effectively communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
  • Standardize our ways of working across markets to improve timeliness and execution on furnishings and move-outs
  • Perform audits and improve data metrics for our guests and internal teams, as well as manage timely data collection to update productivity and achievements on projects
  • Unit/Building/Process information entry, ensuring all fields are accurately filled and clear for other teams
  • Collaborate with operational team members and organizational leaders to identify gaps and opportunities for process improvements
  • Communicate with third party vendors and companies if needed to support OPS/CX operations
  • Specific admin support related to onboarding and move-out of units for our US cities including:
  • Complete utility and telecommunication setups for new units with third party companies (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Complete Package Setups for new units (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Cancel utility and telecommunication accounts for move-outs
  • Support the scheduling of furnishing and onboarding tasks and move-outs:
  • Communicate with third party vendors and buildings to schedule pick ups
  • Input data into our system related to our properties
  • Track disposal and data related to move-outs
  • Support Central Operations, OPS local team, and finance/accounting with ad-hoc projects

What we are looking for:

  • Degree from a top-tier university
  • Min. 1-2 years of experience in a similar role (administrative experience in residential or hospitality experience will be considered as a plus)
  • Fluency in English
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel (formulation, data entry, charts, pivot tables) and Powerpoint
  • Self-starter with a roll up your sleeves mentality and high attention to detail
  • Entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and focus on results
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and with speed

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.

We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services ( SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.

NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB

Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide

Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Quality and Engineering Specialist
description:
About us:

DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.

About the job:

The Specialist in the Quality and Engineering department is a highly experienced professional who takes a leadership role in quality management and technical reference. They are responsible for overseeing and directing high complex quality control processes, leading strategic improvements, and ensuring the company’s adherence to industry’s best practices and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist to oversee quality control and engineering processes for the landing gear MRO.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive quality improvement programs to enhance operational performance.
  • Technical guidance for analysts, ensuring compliance with internal procedures, manuals and best practices.
  • Perform advanced analysis of data, lead root cause investigations, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage and ensure compliance with all aerospace regulations, quality certifications (ANAC, FAA, ISO 9001, etc.) and approved technical data (CMMs and other manufacture manuals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations, supply chain and planning to ensure seamless quality management.
  • Support internal and external audits, providing technical support and assistance during regulatory inspections and certifications.
  • Develop and report on key quality performance indicators, identifying areas for process optimization and cost reduction.
  • Be the technical reference in strategic decision-making regarding quality and process improvements.

Work Experience:

+5 Years of experience working in an aeronautical industry with quality and/or engineering.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).

Educational:

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory

Technical Skills:

Advanced quality tools, drawing interpretations (development is a plus), in-depth knowledge of aeronautical authorities’ regulations (FAA, EASA, ANAC) and ISO 9001 standard or related audit standard requirements.

Obs.: Office and shop floor setting in a regulated aerospace maintenance facility.

May require occasional hands-on inspections or shop visits involving PPE and exposure to aircraft components and tooling.

Work may involve tight deadlines and collaboration across departments.

Location:

100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

Integrity and commitment to ethical business practices

  • Processamento de dados de telemetria, incluindo geolocalização;

  • Aplicação de regras com base em geofences (cercas virtuais) para envio de notificações;

Conhecimentos e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Experiência em design e desenvolvimento de APIs, com preferência por conhecimento em GraphQL.
  • Experiência sólida com Ruby on Rails (diversas versões).
  • Conhecimento desejável em JavaScript, Typescript, Angular, React e Next.js.
  • Pelo menos 7 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, Gitlab, Docker, AWS e PostgreSQL.
  • Conhecimento em microserviços, micro frontends, automação de testes e revisão de código.
  • Experiência com sistemas transacionais de alto volume.
  • Ter trabalhado com tecnologias como Telemática, IoT ou voltadas para veículos será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência com produtos B2B SaaS.

Pré-requisitos Fundamentais:

  • Experiência sólida com design e desenvolvimento de APIs (GraphQL).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Ruby on Rails.
  • Capacidade de explicar e aplicar técnicas padrão de programação (OOP, funcional, etc.).
  • Capacidade de traduzir preocupações de negócio para o contexto tecnológico.
  • Experiência completa no ciclo de vida de aplicações em nuvem (deploy, testes, manutenção).
  • Capacidade de avaliar diferentes abordagens arquiteturais (monolito vs microserviços, por exemplo).
  • Domínio de versionamento de código (Git).
  • Entendimento sobre diferentes mecanismos de armazenamento de dados (PostgreSQL, Redis) e suas vantagens/desvantagens.
  • Vivência com sistemas baseados em mensagens (bus, streaming, pub/sub).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Agile/Lean).

Diferenciais:

description:

Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Domínio de Arquitetura de Software Padrões arquiteturais: Monolito, Microsserviços, Serverless, Event-Driven, Hexagonal, Onion Architecture, Clean Architecture.
  • Design patterns: Singleton, Factory, Adapter, Observer, Strategy, etc.
  • Documentação arquitetural: C4 Model, Diagrama de componentes, sequência, infraestrutura, contexto.
  • Modelagem de SistemasUML, BPMN.Modelagem de domínio (DDD - Domain Driven Design).Especificação de APIs (OpenAPI, Swagger).
  • Excelência em Programação e Engenharia de Software Proficiência em pelo menos uma stack (ex: Java + Spring, .NET, Node.js, Python, etc.).
  • Princípios SOLID, KISS, DRY, YAGNI.Clean Code e práticas de refatoração.
  • Cloud ComputingAWS, Azure ou GCP (ao menos uma das três).
  • Arquiteturas escaláveis e resilientes (Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, CDN).Conceitos de 12-factor app, CI/CD, Infra como Código (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Integrações e APIsRESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets.Mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Pub/Sub).Integração com serviços externos (OAuth2, SAML, Webhooks).
  • Bancos de Dados e Armazenamento SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra).Modelagem, particionamento, replicação, caching.Análise de performance (indexes, query tuning).
  • Arquitetura de Qualidade Observabilidade: logging estruturado (ELK, Datadog), tracing (OpenTelemetry), métricas (Prometheus, Grafana). Testabilidade: TDD, BDD, test coverage, testes de contrato.Performance: análise de latência, throughput, stress testing.
  • Segurança (Security by Design)Autenticação/Autorização (JWT, OAuth2, SSO).Proteções contra ataques (XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection).Gestão de segredos, criptografia, práticas DevSecOps.
  • Governança e Decisões Técnicas Trade-offs entre soluções (ex: latência vs consistência, custo vs performance).Avaliação de tecnologias (build vs buy).Análise de risco técnico. Requisitos não-funcionais.
  • Ferramentas e Práticas de Arquitetura Ferramentas: Draw.io, Lucidchart, ArchiMate, Structurizr, PlantUML.Práticas: ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), Tech Radar, Provas de conceito (PoC), Revisão de arquitetura com times.
  • CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios
  • Vaga híbrida em Santo Amaro (3x presencial na semana- estação de trem/metrô Santo Amaro).

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Corporate Legal Associate
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an Associate to join our corporate legal team at CSBR. In this role, you will work closely with various stakeholders across different departments, providing legal support and reporting directly to the Corporate Legal Counsel. The corporate legal team functions within a dual reporting structure to both the CSBR Country Manager and the Group General Counsel at Saison International, based in Singapore.

The successful candidate will play a key generalist role in providing legal support across all areas of the company, including contract review and drafting, preparation of corporate documents, and delivering legal advice on a range of matters such as compliance, labor, civil, corporate, tax, LGPD and regulatory issues (including matters involving Central Bank of Brazil).

This person will collaborate closely with internal teams — including HR, Finance, Tax, Governance and others — as well as with external professional advisors such as legal counsels and auditors, suppliers and clients.

This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of corporate legal framework, enhance knowledge through implementation of different projects covering different areas of law, and by providing exposure to international multicultural stakeholders.

Main Responsibilities

Legal Advice, Document Drafting and Reviewing

  • Prepare first review, draft and assist corporate legal team to negotiate documents of different areas and variable complexity (such as NDAs, service agreement, engagement letters, software related agreements, employment agreements, head-hunter agreements, lease agreements) ensuring compliance with legal framework, identifying potential risks and providing acceptable mitigation suggestions in a timely manner.
  • Support the Corporate Legal team by analyzing, organizing and aligning comments and changes in contracts reviews with external counsels, key internal and international stakeholders, including the Global Legal & Compliance.
  • Conduct legal research on relevant regulations and case law to support decision making, ensuring contract terms and corporate alignment with latest legal developments and internal policies.
  • Assist corporate legal team in providing tailored legal advice across multiple areas such as corporate governance, labor, tax, civil law and regulatory (including Central Bank matters), ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare first draft, review and coordinate the execution of corporate resolutions, ensuring that all legally and governance-required elements are accurately reflected in the minutes, while also managing, under the Corporate Legal Counsel’s supervision: (i) submissions to the Central Bank and registrations with the Board of Trade; and (ii) registration of the minutes in corporate books, in accordance with local corporate regulation.

General Matters

  • Enhancing internal legal processes, developing standardized templates, performing background checks of services providers, clients and candidates, and implementing best practices to increase efficiency in both legal analysis and compliance.
  • Support Corporate Legal in implementing specific projects related to license application to Central Bank, compliance with LGPD ( Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados ) and GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and corporate tax structuring initiatives.
  • Coordinating cross-functional legal initiatives, preparing materials, improving reporting structures and weekly routines with stakeholders;
  • Collaborate closely with the Governance team by providing legal guidance, reviewing policies and documents to ensure alignment with legal requirements and compliance standards.
  • Coordinate requests for documents to international stakeholders, receipt, translation, notarization and registry with local external counsels and paralegals, in accordance with local regulations.
  • Support the Corporate Legal team by establishing routines to monitor legal updates, sharing relevant information with key stakeholders, assessing potential impacts on the company’s business, and proposing and implementing appropriate solutions.
  • Support knowledge sharing and internal development initiatives through the preparation of materials or participation in training activities

Skills, Experiences & Qualifications

  • 4 - 6 years of post-qualification experience as a Lawyer (preferably some experience working as in-house counsel), desirable experience with corporate, civil, labor and regulatory (Central Bank) law;
  • Bachelor's degree in law;
  • Duly registered with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB);
  • Strong ability to manage priorities;
  • Good organization and proactive profile;
  • Clear and objective communication skills for interaction with diverse internal and external stakeholders;
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken);
  • Excellent legal technical skills and strong attention to detail;
  • Solid interpersonal and collaborative abilities.

Inside Sales Representative

About the Role

Are you a driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment? Do you love building relationships, identifying opportunities, and closing deals? If so, BSI Americas is looking for you!

We're on the lookout for a Bilingual Inside Sales Representative (English & Portuguese) who’s passionate about helping organizations grow through high-quality assurance services and solutions. If you’re motivated, organized, and enjoy collaborating across teams, this could be your next career move.

In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Growth: Propose and close new contracts, meet and exceed revenue goals, and ensure client satisfaction in your territory.
  • Build Relationships: Engage with key decision-makers at small to mid-sized organizations to understand their needs and align our services to support their goals.
  • Prospect Like a Pro: Use a blended approach of outreach—social media, email, cold calling, and more—to grow and manage your sales funnel.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree (BBA preferred).
  • At least 2 years of experience in a consultative inside sales role.
  • 1+ year of experience selling assurance services (a plus!).
  • Proven ability to meet/exceed sales quotas and close deals with confidence.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools like Salesforce, plus the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to adapt and apply a structured sales methodology.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal).

What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, health, vision, dental and life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, short-term and long-term disability, pregnancy and parental leave, registered savings plan, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

title: Risk&Fraud Analyst
description:
Company Description

Gravity Interactive is the North American wholly-owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd. – one of the most prominent online game publishers in South Korea, which now operates several subsidiaries across the globe. With the great success of Ragnarok Online, one of the first PC MMORPGs that inspired a generation of RPG fans, Gravity Interactive strives to become a major publisher in the online gaming industry that lives up to its reputation through continuous servicing of the currently existing online games as well as a wide variety of new and innovative entertainment contents to gamers in North America and beyond.

With operations in many countries and over 20 published games across the Gravity portfolio, we offer numerous growth opportunities, varied projects and stability. If you are a passionate and driven individual who is looking to level up your career and gain exposure to the global gaming market, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Role Description

This position will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and preventing fraudulent activities within online transactions, payments, and in-game purchases. The Risk & Fraud Analyst will collaborate with multiple departments to identify suspicious behavior, minimize chargebacks, and ensure a safe and trustworthy environment for all players. 

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyze payment transactions to detect and prevent fraudulent activity.
  • Investigate suspicious patterns in in-game purchases, account activities, and player behavior.
  • Implement risk management strategies to minimize chargebacks, fraud losses, and abuse of promotions.
  • Create and maintain fraud detection rules, alerts, and workflows.
  • Collaborate with Customer Support, Finance, and Development teams to resolve fraud-related cases.
  • Provide regular reports on fraud metrics, trends, and prevention effectiveness.
  • Stay updated with industry best practices, fraud schemes, and evolving security threats.
  • Recommend improvements to fraud prevention tools, processes, and policies.
  • Assist in compliance with payment regulations and security standards.

Qualifications

  • Prior experience in fraud detection, risk analysis, or payment operations (gaming, fintech, or e-commerce experience is a plus).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with online payment systems, chargeback processes, and fraud prevention tools.
  • Attention to detail with ability to identify suspicious patterns in large datasets.
  • Proficiency in Excel and data analysis.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Knowledge of online gaming ecosystems and digital goods transactions is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with PC gaming and MMORPGs
  • Positive and professional attitude
  • Fluent Brazilian Portuguese
  • Lives in Brazil
  • Advanced English reading and writing skills
  • Korean language skills a plus

title: Internal Control Coordinator
description:
Ready to lead the risk management and compliance agenda across Latin America? As Internal Controls Coordinator at Kellanova, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and mitigating financial risks through a strong internal control framework. Your expertise will ensure robust compliance with SOX requirements, corporate standards, and risk mitigation practices—while partnering with senior leaders to strengthen our control culture across the region.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work with cross-functional teams, lead high-impact assessments, manage control reporting, and influence strategic decisions that protect the integrity of our operations in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

A Taste of What You’ll Be Doing

  • Conduct Regional Control Assessments – Perform periodic reviews of process and procedural compliance across the LA region, ensuring risks are identified early and mitigated effectively.
  • Drive SOX Compliance – Lead execution and documentation of Key Financial Controls (KFCs), including testing and reporting deliverables in line with SOX 404 requirements.
  • Manage Control Reporting & Analysis – Consolidate and analyze control results, provide regular updates to key stakeholders, and identify trends and areas of improvement.
  • Oversee Remediation & Compliance – Track and follow up on action plans, ensuring timely and effective remediation of identified control deficiencies and gaps.
  • Lead Stakeholder Engagement – Collaborate with Finance VPs, General Managers, Global Control leaders, and GBS partners to drive control awareness and compliance excellence across the region.

We’re Looking for Someone With

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in internal controls, SOX compliance, or audit within multinational environments.
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) and advanced Spanish
  • Proven experience managing teams and leading through influence.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills with high attention to detail.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP and Microsoft Excel; SAP experience is preferred.
  • Proactive mindset, with the ability to work across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.

What’s Next

After you apply, your application will be reviewed by a real recruiter, so it may take us a few weeks to get back with you by email or phone. Visit our to get insights into our hiring process and more about what we offer.

If you join our team, you’ll be rewarded for the difference you make. Our comprehensive benefits offer you the support you need through your life events, big or small. Visit our benefits page & be sure to ask your recruiter for more specific information.

Get to Know Us

At Kellanova, we are driven by our vision to be the world’s best-performing snacks-led powerhouse, unleashing the full potential of our differentiated brands and our passionate people. Our portfolio of iconic, world-class brands include Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, MorningStar Farms, Special K, Krave, Zucaritas, Tresor, Crunchy Nut, among others.

Kellanova’s Culture of Best means we bring our best to all that we do in pursuit of our vision to be the world’s best performing snacks-led powerhouse. Our culture celebrates boldness and empowers our people to challenge the status quo, achieve results, and win together.Our focus on Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion (ED&I) enables us to build a culture of belonging where all employees have a place at the table and are inspired to share their passion, talents and ideas to work.

Mars has agreed to acquire Kellanova in a combination that will shape the future of snacking! The transaction is anticipated to close towards the end of 2025 (subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals). The companies remain separate until closing.

You can learn more at and our hiring teams will be happy to discuss further questions if your application advances in the hiring process.

title: Teste de Componentes Automotivos - Analista
description:
Sobre a oportunidade: O teste de componentes é uma etapa crucial no desenvolvimento de sistemas, focando na avaliação de componentes individuais de hardware e software para garantir sua funcionalidade e segurança. Nesta posição, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar diretamente com nossos colegas da matriz na Alemanha, participando de atividades essenciais para garantir a qualidade e a segurança dos sistemas ADAS. Sua rotina envolverá a preparação e automação de testes, monitoramento de desempenho dos componentes, identificação e reporte de falhas, além da verificação de soluções implementadas.

Você também trabalhará com simulações em bancadas/HiLs (Hardware-in-the-Loop), contribuindo para o desenvolvimento dos módulos ADAS. Essa fase é crucial para testar a interação dos componentes em um ambiente controlado, permitindo ajustes e melhorias antes da integração final no veículo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir testes e simulações de módulos ADAS em bancadas/HiLs durante a fase de desenvolvimento.
  • Preparar, automatizar e executar testes, além de reportar falhas e verificar soluções para os problemas identificados.
  • Implementação de casos de teste baseados em requisitos e desenvolvimento constante da automação de testes
  • Utilização de ferramentas para codificar sistemas de teste, capturar traces de diagnóstico e simular estados operacionais

Requisitos e qualificações:

Qualificações necessárias

  • Graduação completa ou próxima de finalizar em: Engenharia Elétrica/Eletrônica, Automotiva, Mecatrônica, Mecânica, Ciência da Computação, tecnólogo em eletrônica automotiva ou afins
  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência no ramo automotivo com ferramentas de diagnóstico (CANoe/CANalyzer, CANape, ECU-Test)
  • Soft skills: Raciocínio lógico, capacidade analítica e organizacional, proatividade e trabalho em equipe

Qualificações diferenciais

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento do produto no ramo automotivo e/ou conhecimento em módulos eletrônicos e eletrônica automotiva
  • Experiência com teste de sistemas ADAS / ECUs
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de comunicação automotiva
  • Conhecimentos de programação em Python, C++, Vector CAPL
  • Conehcimentos de Matlab / SImulink
  • Certificação ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level / Test Analyst

title: Internal Control Coordinator
description:
Ready to lead the risk management and compliance agenda across Latin America? As an Internal Controls Coordinator at Kellanova, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and mitigating financial risks through a strong internal control framework. Your expertise will ensure robust compliance with SOX requirements, corporate standards, and risk mitigation practices—while partnering with senior leaders to strengthen our control culture across the region.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work with cross-functional teams, lead high-impact assessments, manage control reporting, and influence strategic decisions that protect the integrity of our operations in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

A Taste of What You’ll Be Doing

  • Conduct Regional Control Assessments – Perform periodic reviews of process and procedural compliance across the LA region, ensuring risks are identified early and mitigated effectively.
  • Drive SOX Compliance – Lead execution and documentation of Key Financial Controls (KFCs), including testing and reporting deliverables in line with SOX 404 requirements.
  • Manage Control Reporting & Analysis – Consolidate and analyze control results, provide regular updates to key stakeholders, and identify trends and areas of improvement.
  • Oversee Remediation & Compliance – Track and follow up on action plans, ensuring timely and effective remediation of identified control deficiencies and gaps.
  • Lead Stakeholder Engagement – Collaborate with Finance VPs, General Managers, Global Control leaders, and GBS partners to drive control awareness and compliance excellence across the region.

We’re Looking for Someone With

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 5+ years of experience in internal controls, SOX compliance, or audit within multinational environments.
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) and Advanced Spanish.
  • Proven experience managing teams and leading through influence.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills with high attention to detail.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP and Microsoft Excel; SAP experience is preferred.
  • Proactive mindset, with the ability to work across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.

What’s Next

After you apply, your application will be reviewed by a real recruiter, so it may take us a few weeks to get back with you by email or phone. Visit our to get insights into our hiring process and more about what we offer.

If you join our team, you’ll be rewarded for the difference you make. Our comprehensive benefits offer you the support you need through your life events, big or small. Visit our benefits page & be sure to ask your recruiter for more specific information.

Get to Know Us

At Kellanova, we are driven by our vision to be the world’s best-performing snacks-led powerhouse, unleashing the full potential of our differentiated brands and our passionate people. Our portfolio of iconic, world-class brands include Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, MorningStar Farms, Special K, Krave, Zucaritas, Tresor, Crunchy Nut, among others.

Kellanova’s Culture of Best means we bring our best to all that we do in pursuit of our vision to be the world’s best performing snacks-led powerhouse. Our culture celebrates boldness and empowers our people to challenge the status quo, achieve results, and win together.Our focus on Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion (ED&I) enables us to build a culture of belonging where all employees have a place at the table and are inspired to share their passion, talents and ideas to work.

Mars has agreed to acquire Kellanova in a combination that will shape the future of snacking! The transaction is anticipated to close towards the end of 2025 (subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals). The companies remain separate until closing.

You can learn more at and our hiring teams will be happy to discuss further questions if your application advances in the hiring process.

Let’s shape the future of snacking.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, disability, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, sexual orientation, age, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Aqui na NV, buscamos alguém que enxergue nos dados uma fonte de inovação. Se você gosta de desafios, tem ideias que transformam e vontade de criar soluções de impacto, queremos conhecer você!

Responsabilidades:

  • Construir, manter e aprimorar continuamente a engenharia e os pipelines de dados da NV.
  • Planejar e governar a infraestrutura necessária (licenças, servidores e nuvem), garantindo disponibilidade e acuracidade das informações.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em engenharia e arquitetura de dados (construção e manutenção de pipelines).

  • Conhecimento em fluxo de dados CDC.
  • Conhecimento de estatística e ciência de dados.

Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição - Benefício flexível que você pode utilizar entre o Vale Alimentação para utilizar em mercados e fazer sua própria comida, ou pelo Vale Refeição, para utilizar em restaurantes e pedir seu lanche;

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior para atuar no suporte e evolução do ambiente de tecnologia da informação da empresa. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir a disponibilidade, segurança e performance das soluções utilizadas no dia a dia, além de apoiar usuários, participar de projetos estratégicos de TI e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos internos.

Nosso ambiente conta majoritariamente com soluções em nuvem e terceirizadas, além de um servidor local e infraestrutura híbrida integrada ao *Office 365 e Active Directory*.

Principais responsabilidades

• Administração e suporte ao ambiente *Office 365* (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, etc.);

• Gestão e manutenção de *Active Directory* (usuários, grupos, políticas de acesso e segurança);

• Apoio à gestão de *plataforma de chamados* (abertura, priorização, acompanhamento e métricas de SLA);

• Suporte de 2º e 3º nível a usuários e estações de trabalho (Windows/Mac, periféricos, rede local, impressoras, etc.);

• Administração e monitoramento do *servidor local* e integração com soluções em nuvem;

• Apoio em projetos de TI (migrações, rollouts, upgrades de software, novas soluções de infraestrutura, etc.);

• Gestão de acessos e perfis de segurança, garantindo aderência a políticas de *LGPD e compliance*;

• Monitoramento e documentação da infraestrutura e dos processos técnicos;

• Atuação em incidentes críticos e apoio na recuperação de desastres (DRP).

Requisitos técnicos

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente);

• Experiência comprovada em administração de ambientes híbridos (local + nuvem);

Conhecimentos sólidos em:

• Office 365 e Microsoft 365 Admin

• Active Directory e GPO*

• Redes (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewall)

• Windows Server

• Experiência em ferramentas de gestão de chamados (Jira, GLPI, OTRS, Freshservice, ServiceNow ou similares);

• Noções de segurança da informação (MFA, IAM, boas práticas CIS, ISO 27001, LGPD);

• Experiência em troubleshooting e suporte a usuários de nível executivo.

Diferenciais desejáveis

• Certificações Microsoft (MCSA, MS-900, AZ-104 ou equivalentes);

• Experiência com *Intune/Endpoint Manager*;

• Conhecimento em ITIL ou práticas de gestão de serviços;

• Vivência em projetos de migração para nuvem e integração de sistemas.

Perfil esperado

• Postura *proativa e consultiva*, buscando sempre antecipar problemas;

• Boa comunicação para lidar com diferentes níveis da organização (da operação ao board);

• Organização e disciplina para gestão de chamados, prazos e prioridades;

• Capacidade de atuar tanto em operações de rotina quanto em projetos estratégicos;

• Comprometimento com segurança, disponibilidade e performance do ambiente tecnológico.

O que oferecemos

• Ambiente inovador e em crescimento, com forte uso de tecnologia;

• Autonomia para propor melhorias e participar de decisões estratégicas de TI;

• Oportunidade de aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuo;

title: Executivo de Vendas
description:
Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!

A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.

Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.

Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!

Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolvimento de Negócios:

Prospectar e qualificar leads em hospitais, clínicas, ambulatórios e organizações sociais de saúde;

Desenvolver pipeline de vendas robusto com foco em instituições de pequeno e médio porte;

Realizar análise de mercado e identificação de oportunidades de expansão;

Elaborar propostas comerciais técnicas e financeiras personalizadas;

Negociar contratos de licenciamento, implementação e suporte do SX SIGMA e demais empresas do ecossistema Salux;

Relacionamento com Clientes:

Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com diretores, gestores de TI e profissionais de saúde;

Conduzir apresentações executivas e demonstrações técnicas do produto;

Participar de eventos do setor, feiras e congressos médicos;

Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais em potenciais clientes;

Acompanhar clientes durante o processo de implementação para garantir satisfação;

Consultoria Técnica:

Atuar como consultor especializado em soluções HIS e transformação digital na saúde;

Compreender as necessidades específicas de cada instituição e propor soluções adequadas;

Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes técnicas para customização de propostas;

Orientar clientes sobre benefícios da digitalização e compliance com regulamentações (SBIS/CFM, LGPD);

Apoiar na elaboração de business cases e ROI para justificar investimentos.

Gestão de Vendas:

Atingir e superar metas de vendas mensais, trimestrais e anuais;

Manter CRM atualizado com informações precisas do pipeline;

Elaborar relatórios de atividades e previsões de vendas;

Participar de reuniões de forecast e planejamento estratégico;

Colaborar com equipes de marketing para desenvolvimento de materiais comerciais.

Requisitos Técnicos:

Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Medicina, Enfermagem ou áreas correlatas;

Desejável pós-graduação em Gestão em Saúde, MBA em Vendas, Tecnologia da Informação ou Administração Hospitalar;

Será considerado um diferencial possuir certificações em metodologias de vendas (SPIN Selling, Challenger Sale) ou gestão de projetos (PMP, Agile);

Experiência mínima de 3 anos em vendas consultivas de soluções tecnológicas complexas;

Experiência em vendas B2B com ciclos longos (6-18 meses);

Vivência no setor de saúde (hospitais, clínicas, operadoras) com conhecimento dos fluxos operacionais hospitalares;

Experiência com software/SaaS para mercado corporativo;

Experiência em sistemas HIS (Hospital Information System).

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento full stack da solução: front-end e back-end escaláveis, performáticos e seguros.
  • Projetar e implementar APIs (REST e eventos) com foco em integração entre áreas e sistemas internos/externos.
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DevOps com foco em automação e qualidade.
  • Garantir práticas modernas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) para provisionamento e governança em AWS.
  • Apoiar na definição e validação de casos de testes funcionais e não funcionais, assegurando a qualidade e confiabilidade do software.
  • Desenvolver rotinas de integração e tratamento de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Implementar estratégias de cache e persistência para garantir performance.
  • Participar da arquitetura da solução, com foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e governança.
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais (desenvolvimento, arquitetura, segurança e dados).
  • Garantir o versionamento, rastreabilidade e segurança no ciclo de vida da aplicação.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Requisitos Técnicos Imprescindíveis:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
  • Sólido domínio de linguagens:
  • Java (Spring Boot / Spring Batch)
  • Python
  • JavaScript (Node.js e React)

Experiência comprovada com:

  • DevOps e CI/CD (Git, pipelines, automação de deploys)
  • Framework de testes (ex.: JUnit, Pytest, Postman, etc)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou equivalente)
  • AWS Cloud: EKS, S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, Elasticache (Redis), API
  • Kubernetes (EKS ou Rancher)
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços e integração via Mulesoft APIs ou REST
  • Práticas modernas de observabilidade, logs e segurança em aplicações distribuídas

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis:

  • Certificação AWS Solutions Architect Associate ou Professional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensageria e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka, EventBridge)
  • Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em nuvem e LGPD
  • Experiência anterior em projetos no setor de seguros ou financeiro
  • Conhecimento em soluções de autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, JWT, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em Oracle Siebel CRM
  • Fluência em práticas ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)

title: ANALISTA DE GESTAO E DADOS PL
description:
Quem é a Stone?

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. title: Remote Baker Role - 42981
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview

Turing is seeking baking professionals to join the Common Lives Project —a research initiative to collect real-world footage that trains AI systems. You and a colleague from the same bakery or workspace will wear GoPro cameras while baking and managing prep throughout the day.

Responsibilities:

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment

Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage

Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips

Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative

Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely
